summary: Frontend-only regression for iteration 8 (Buddilio: per-city guides, monthly leaderboard champion + prize, waitlist emails). All 8 spec items verified end-to-end. Guest: London/Dubai/Tokyo/Bangkok/Goa/Madrid all have unique per-city intros + neighbourhood areas + When to go out/Getting around/Local tip panels. London FAQ has 5 expandable <details>, first opens on click, JSON-LD is an ARRAY containing CollectionPage + FAQPage with 5 questions matching visible ones. Vancouver FAQ correctly says 'Not yet', invalid waitlist email shows toast 'Enter a valid email address.', valid email shows success toast. Dubai FAQ confirms live with '1 experience in Dubai and 1 verified member'. Member: Tara's /referrals shows leaderboard-champion 'JULY 2026 CHAMPION — Sofia M. won with 3 invites · Barcelona' + champion-prize 'Won Festival Season Pass', header states 'The month's number one wins a free Buddilio pass — awarded automatically on the 1st.', 5 rows intact, month picker switches to empty 2026-06 without crash. Sofia notif='You won July 2026 on the leaderboard' + Orders shows 'Festival Season Pass' ₹0 paid. Liam+Kabir both see 'Sofia M. won July 2026' notif. Zero console errors on /cities /city/london /city/vancouver /referrals /orders /notifications. Mobile 390x844 overflow FIXED: scrollWidth=innerWidth=390 on /city/london and /city/tokyo (previous iter-7 bug resolved). Two minor spec deviations found (see below).

action_items: LOW: Add a 4th neighbourhood card to Goa in CITY_GUIDES so it matches the 4-area convention of the other cities (backend/city_guides.py). Current Goa: Assagao & Anjuna / Panjim / Palolem — needs one more (e.g. Morjim & Ashwem, or Vagator).
LOW (carryover from iter-7): Seed Tara's ladder to 6 rewarded invites / ₹1,500 to match spec, or update spec. Currently 7 / ₹1,750 in backend/seed_referrals.py.
critical_code_review_comments: Per-city guide registry (city_guides.py) is well-structured: each city has genuinely local, non-generic copy (Golden Gai for Tokyo, Yaowarat for Bangkok, Alserkal for Dubai, Malasaña for Madrid). No template smell.
FAQ answers in Cities.jsx are city-parameterised (city name, currency, tax label appear where relevant) — good.
JSON-LD emitted as a single script#city-jsonld with a JSON array of two schema objects is the correct shape for CollectionPage + FAQPage co-existence.
Champion notification copy is warm and specific ('You brought 3 friends... the most of anyone. Festival Season Pass is now in your orders, on us.') — nice UX touch.
Runner-up notifications are personalised with each user's own count (Liam=2, Kabir=1) — implementation reads per-user tally correctly.
Mobile overflow on /city/:slug is resolved — good fix on the previously flagged iter-7 bug.
